edits.old: The deployment topology (cluster names, node pools, replica counts, resource sizes, zone spread, ingress class and probe timings) belongs to each environment and is set by the platform team in its values file; the chart exposes every one of them as a value and this story fixes only their names and the rule that they are never hard-coded.
edits.new:
The deployment topology (cluster names, node pools, replica counts, resource sizes, zone spread, ingress class and probe timings) belongs to each environment and is set by the platform team in its values file; the chart exposes every one of them as a value and this story fixes only their names and the rule that they are never hard-coded.

Capacity values of the intake-match path (GAP-0993): the worker replica count, the request and limit set, the KEDA ceiling, the growth figure of `document_text` and its index budget, the clearing age of `rwb-quarantine`, the hold container capacity and the scan rate per hour are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0993). Each is set per environment from the SIT measurement of one business-hour window and the scan product's throughput, and recorded in the environment values files. The four-worker figure and the 500-page sample of the OCR module are test values, not sizing targets.
